other_failure_modes.name: Feature distribution leakage across CV folds
other_failure_modes.description: PCA and group-level statistics (mean and standard deviation by sex) are fitted on the entire training dataset prior to cross-validation. This leaks information from validation folds into the training folds, making out-of-fold scores less reliable and potentially distorting the ensemble weights.

other_failure_modes.name: Failure to drop ID column
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the target column from the training data but does not explicitly drop the 'id' column. If an ID column is present in the dataset, it is treated as a numeric feature, which can cause overfitting in tree-based models.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated and generally correct pipeline, featuring extensive domain-specific feature engineering, multi-seed cross-validation, and an optimized ensemble. However, there is data leakage during cross-validation because PCA and group aggregations are fitted on the entire training set before the CV splits. Additionally, the agent fails to drop the 'id' column from the feature set, which could introduce overfitting.
